name: Sonya Ostovar
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Manhattan Beach, California
about: As managing partner of Taylor & Ring in Manhattan Beach, California, Sonya Ostovar stands as a formidable advocate for plaintiffs across the Los Angeles area. Focusing on personal injury and employment law on behalf of employees, she dedicates her practice to protecting individual rights against powerful entities. A committed trial lawyer with over a decade of experience, she ensures that victims of negligence and workplace injustice receive the strategic leadership and relentless representation necessary to secure accountability.

Over the course of her legal career, Ms. Ostovar has achieved remarkable success fighting for the rights of survivors of childhood sexual abuse and sexual assault. Her noteworthy courtroom advocacy includes securing a landmark $8 million settlement for a teenager abused by a coach. Furthermore, she was instrumental in obtaining a historic settlement exceeding $46 million against the city of Santa Monica on behalf of a class of sexual abuse victims.

Ms. Ostovar graduated magna cum laude from the University of California, Los Angeles, in 2011 with a bachelor’s degree in philosophy before earning her Juris Doctor from the Pepperdine Caruso School of Law. While at law school, she served as senior editor of the Dispute Resolution Law Journal and earned a certificate from the Straus Institute for Dispute Resolution. She was admitted to practice law in California in 2015.

Deeply committed to her clients, Ms. Ostovar prioritizes personalization and open communication, ensuring every individual feels heard and supported throughout the legal process. An active member of the legal community, she serves on the Board of Governors for the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles (CAALA). Her dedication to mentoring future advocates includes previous leadership roles as chair and vice chair of the CAALA New Lawyers Committee, as well as chair of the CAALA Law School Outreach Committee.
